title: A memorable day in Andalusia
text:
This was the kind of day in Spain that stays with you long after the journey ends - full of dramatic landscapes, unexpected moments and the unmistakable magic of Andalusia.

Driving to the white villages, we had an unexpected visit to the olive oil factory including an olive oil tasting - which was much fun . The white villages themselves were spectacular. I particularly liked the first one we went to - Zahara. It was so wonderfully serene.

title: Very satisfying visit!
text: Our guide Maria illustrated and accompanied us through the various activities: visit to an olive oil producer, visit to the white villages, lunch, and finally Ronda. Everything perfect!
author: albertononno

title: White villages and Rhonda
text: Very good trip . Karlos our guide was very fluent in English, was very knowledgeable and gave us clear instructions at each location. He answered everyone's questions. Great character and sense of humour. The driver too was very good. I loved the olive oil tasting. Not enough time to look around after lunch but this was made up with more than ample time in Rhonda.  Also gave us information on places to eat in Seville.
author: Getaway48189136626

title: Escape for the day
text:
Day excursion in the Andalusian countryside that is clearly worth the price: an olive oil factory, two villages, and a city ranging from charming to impressive.
Admittedly, there is (inevitably) a lot of travel time. But this is compensated for by the contemplation of the landscapes as well as by the guide's commentary that punctuates these moments.
Furthermore, the latter (Karlos) was impeccable: funny, jovial, and insightful. He always has the right word and advice to give.
I can only recommend him!
Thanks again :)
author: 356guillemt

title: Most perfect tour!
text:
Merce was our phenomenal tour guide!! She was exceptional with speaking English and Italian!!! I enjoyed being able to hear our tour in both languages and didn’t miss anything! Our driver, Diego, was incredible as he maneuvered our coach bus along extremely narrow roads!
We especially loved our olive grove and refinery! Our lunch in Rondo was amazing!
author: d0rannec

title: Zahara, Grazalema and Ronda
text: We had 2 guides who were good! Coco and Toni? A tall guy who was good. We loved Zahara, enjoyed the olive oil tasting  and had lunch at Grazalema. It's a windy road there so take some Dramamine. Then on to Ronda. The gorge was interested. City was getting ready for it's bullfghting feast. To us Ronda was underwhelming. Made famous by Americans and touristy. I would recommend for a one time.
author: sandraw881

title: Beautiful tour.
text: Interesting visit with an exceptional guide, Álvaro Cortez, a nice, knowledgeable, and helpful person. We visited Zahara, Grazalema, where a fair was taking place with the running of the bulls loose through the city streets, and finally Ronda. For all the destinations, he provided us with the necessary explanations. Personally, I would have liked to stay a little longer in Ronda, but that doesn't change the fact that overall it was a fantastic day. Great job, Álvaro!!
author: Seaside50490529297

title: Day trip to Ronda and the White Villages from Seville
text: Tour was well paced with plenty of time at each location. Condition of the bus was very good, with comfortable seats and usb outlets available at each seat to keep your electronics charged.  I highly recommend Naturanda based on their clear communication, centrally located meeting offices, and organization. Maria was our tour guide. She provided excellent commentary throughout the excursion.
